decision.summary: Two regions stand out: (1) a transient multi-sample offset around index 420–435 with asymmetric N/E response and U spike; (2) a prolonged E descent (~610–660) with divergent N/U behavior and an abrupt E reversal near 660. Both show cross-axis shape complexity beyond noise or smooth drift.

regions.observation: Multi-sample downward shift in N and E (≈2–3 MAD), followed by a partial return in E but not N; U shows a concurrent sharp dip then recovery—suggests possible transient offset or platform with asymmetric cross-axis behavior.

Broad, slow descent in E (≈4 MAD) from ~610 to ~660, accompanied by modest N decline and U rise; after ~660, E reverses sharply upward while N continues drifting down—ambiguous superposition of opposing trends, possibly indicating complex motion or multi-phase event.
